mapper.sql: id, session_id, kind, visibility, state, idempotency_key, payload_json, source_run_id, claimed_by_run_id, lease_until_ms, created_at_ms, delivered_at_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_agent_session_inbox ( session_id, kind, visibility, state, idempotency_key, payload_json, source_run_id, created_at_ms, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{kind}, #{visibility}, #{state}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{sourceRunId}, #{createdAtMs}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_session_inbox SET state = 'PENDING', claimed_by_run_id = NULL, lease_until_ms = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND claimed_by_run_id = #{runId} AND state = 'CLAIMED' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE ai_agent_session_inbox SET state = 'HELD', claimed_by_run_id = NULL, lease_until_ms = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND kind = 'USER_MESSAGE' AND state IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED') AND deleted = 0

UPDATE ai_agent_session_inbox SET state = 'PENDING', update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND kind = 'USER_MESSAGE' AND state = 'HELD' AND deleted = 0
AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent_session_inbox WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND state IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED') AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent_session_inbox WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND kind = 'USER_MESSAGE' AND state = 'HELD' AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM ai_agent_session_inbox WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND kind = 'USER_MESSAGE' AND deleted = 0 AND ( state = 'PENDING' OR (state = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_until_ms < #{nowMs}) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
